text: With otherwise identical small-scale training datasets, the paper reports that process supervision from PRMlarge significantly outperforms both outcome supervision from PRMlarge and outcome supervision from final-answer checking at all data collection scales (best-of-500), and that outcome supervision from PRMlarge is noticeably more effective than final-answer checking, which the authors attribute to better supervision of correct-answer solutions with incorrect reasoning.
title: Controlled small-scale test: process supervision beats both forms of outcome supervision
